recommendation_summary: Act now by using the existing shared list to pull out every unfinished cake due today, give each one to a preparer, check at the counter that it's ready before pickup, and make these cakes the priority over next month's orders. Before next week, find out why staff picked later orders first. The first partner session should only demonstrate a preparation-queue workflow using real orders. The sales, inventory and manufacturing sync stays on hold until the partner shows which other problem each module would solve. Unmet: the reply never sets up an ongoing daily due-today filter or sort for the morning baker, so the fix reads as a one-day triage plus a root-cause check.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need every cake due today prepared before pickup.
labels.Deleted: A full system migration as a prerequisite for fixing pickup misses.
labels.Bottleneck: Preparation is happening out of pickup-date order; today’s cakes remain unmade.
labels.Checked myself: From your account, everyone can read the shared list, and payments and stock reconcile correctly; the reason staff selected later orders is still unknown.

note: The reply prioritises today's due cakes from the existing list and only conditionally defers the Odoo sync; 'full system migration' clearly refers to the proposed Odoo rollout, and the checked facts are drawn from the user's own account.
